_comment: The colour pairs the contrast gate holds (terminal design guidelines §2.1, §6 A1–A2). `text` pairs need 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3); `boundary` pairs need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11: a control's border, the focus ring, a selected-state bar). Every pair is checked in BOTH themes, with alpha colours blended over the surface they sit on. Add a pair when a new text or boundary token meets a surface.
